source.identity_verified_scope: audited saved bytes only; original TU/build not certified

semantic_contract.scope: One source-pinned saved C function; local scalar properties only
semantic_contract.abi_status: Explicit experimental two's-complement signed-long bit-vector contracts; original ABI unknown
semantic_contract.smt_division: bvsdiv, always paired with C definedness
semantic_contract.c_division_definedness: denominator != 0 AND NOT(numerator == LONG_MIN AND denominator == -1)
semantic_contract.literal_conversions: 0, 1000 and 100000 are exactly representable in both modeled signed-long widths. Mixed literal/long operations use the common signed-long type under usual arithmetic conversions. No assumption about the original int width is needed for these constants and operations.
semantic_contract.outer_division_precondition: The inner quotient must be nonzero before the outer C division is evaluated; signed-division overflow must also be excluded.
semantic_contract.fault_query_policy: Query branch entry and defined inner division and zero outer denominator. Do not assume the outer division is defined in this fault query. Never interpret Z3's totalized divide-by-zero value as a C result.
semantic_contract.nonpositive_path: srate <= 0 returns 0 without executing either C division

query_B.caller_assumption_origin: human-added experimental hypothesis; neither extracted nor proven from original project

semantic_contract.source_admission: Hash-match original dataset, audit record and UTF-8 function string, then full-match the entire reviewed function grammar. No substring search, C execution, generic C parser, or recovery AST certification.
semantic_contract.source_coordinates: Saved function lines 1 declaration, 3 guard, 4 nested division. Original location metadata is separately preserved and unverified.
semantic_contract.reference_arithmetic: Independent Python arbitrary-precision abs(n)//abs(d) plus sign; no floats and no Z3 in the reference calculation
semantic_contract.unsat_proof_status: Z3 solver result only; no proof certificate requested or independently checked
